responsibility: This is the common target configuration header for GCC on OpenVMS. It defines VMS target macros for predefined preprocessor symbols, object and executable suffixes, identifier syntax, ABI selection, core type sizes such as long/pointer/size_t/ptrdiff_t, debugger and DWARF conventions, libc capability policy, and the frontend/backend hook bindings that connect GCC to VMS-specific pragma registration, include handling, option override logic, and function section behavior.
same_name_distinction: Provides the shared target configuration interface for OpenVMS: unlike vms.cc, it does not perform runtime-name patching or emission work, and unlike vms.opt, it does not declare command-line switches. Instead it defines the target macros, ABI/type/layout policy, predefined symbols, and hook assignments that make the VMS backend available to the rest of GCC.
